summary: Frontend-only verification of EZtoFind listings promotion, save-search modal, and Referral Requests admin dashboard. All 7 target flows verified passing against live preview URL.

issues: Console hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option> (ListingsNext.jsx line 258). Caused by visual-editor instrumentation injecting <span data-ve-dynamic> inside <option>. Not functionally breaking but produces repeated console errors on every page load.

verified_flows: /listings renders listings-next with ln-search, ln-count, ln-map, ln-save-search
Save Search modal opens; submitting without consent shows ln-save-error 'Please check both consent boxes.' and does NOT submit
Submitting with CASL+PIPA checked -> ln-save-success 'Check your inbox' confirmation shown (POST /api/saved-searches succeeded)

/admin/referral-requests standalone page renders referral-requests-panel with rr-total, rr-window, rr-cities, rr-clicks (=3), days selector; switching to Last 365 days refetches and shows Kelowna/Victoria/Nelson chips
/admin/referrals tabs: admin-referrals-tabs present; default Network tab shows tracker; clicking Incoming Requests tab renders referral-requests-panel; switching back hides it
action_items: Low priority: Fix hydration warning in ListingsNext.jsx around line 258 — the beds <option> content is being wrapped in a <span> by the editor instrumentation. Consider using plain static text for option children or disabling the dynamic wrapper for <option> elements.
critical_code_review_comments: Visual-editor instrumentation injects <span> inside <option> which React treats as invalid HTML and will cause hydration mismatches in SSR builds.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All data-testids wired correctly. Save-search POST succeeded end-to-end with double opt-in confirmation. Click-interest cities present for 365-day window (Kelowna 7, Victoria 3, Nelson 1). Only observation is a non-blocking console hydration warning from visual-editor spans injected inside <option> in ListingsNext.jsx line 258.
